{{Otheruses|Butter}}
'''Huttese lard-butter''' was a kind of food. Presumably it was a kind of butter made by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], or their servants. The kitchen on [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] had two vats of Huttese lard-butter.<ref name="Between the Worlds">''{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: MidWorld}}''</ref>
